avis.texte: This moisturizer is a must for me. I have dry, mature skin and live in a hot, humid climate. The cream is rich enough for my skin, preps for makeup but does not leave a slick or greasy finish. I also love the tube vs jar (more sanitary).
I have the most oily skin ever and this leaves me looking amazing while still keeping my skin hydrated, if you struggle with oily skin get this moisture! Its the best.

I have extremely oily skin, and this moisturizer is absolutely perfect! It's lightweight (like the name says) and hydrating without making my skin overly oily as the day goes on. And you can't beat the price!

avis.titre: A total gem in a sea of Moisturizers!
avis.texte: An amazing, lightweight formula, that absorbs into skin leaving it soft with a little plump. I reach for it all the time vs. moisturizers in jars. It's a go-to in warm weather. My temperamental, sensive skin loves it, and I can't believe this convenient tube has all these great ingredients for that price point. I'm on my first tube, but this will be a repurchase! I'm not Gate keeping.

Not so "lightweight" compared to other dermatologist recommend brands… (cerave, ordinary, etc) it feels more like a thick night cream vs a daily moisturizer, but someone with extremely dry skin might benefit more from this than oily/other types

i do not have crazy sensitive or acne prone skin, and i have a really good track record with good molecules, but unfortunately after a few days of regular use, it clogged up my pores like crazy all over my face.
It's nice and lightweight and not heavy feeling, and it's very moisturizing and leaves your skin feeling very soft! I would buy this again!

I'm a bit of a minimalist, and this moisturizer does exactly what I want it to at a nice price point. Gentle, just-right hydration for my sensitive, aging skin. No greasy feel, no irritating scent, and it can be layered or used alone.
Tried brand for first time, looking for new daily moisturizer. So far so good. Not greasy, absorbs quickly, no fragrance.
This product is true to the name as a lightweight moisturizer. It is perfect for the warmer months ahead. Can easily apply sunscreen on top without any interaction (ie. clumping, peeling).

I dont understand how there are so many good reviews. I tried it and within minutes, my face felt tight and dry. Its no different than putting water on your face. It does absolutely nothing. I'm not sure abt their other products, but this is a major flop. Don't let all the good reviews fool you.

At first, I really liked this moisturizer because it felt good, but it gave me the worst breakout. I have had in six months!!! Im still working on clearing it up. Be careful if you habe sensitive or acne prone skin

avis.titre: Awesome high end moisturizer at excellent price
avis.texte: This is a great lightweight moisturizer. Absorbs quickly, non-greasy, and just a little dot goes a lonnggg way. Only cap is recyclable, but the product will last you a long time unlike pricier products.
Keep going back again and again for this moisturizer. Its affordable, and leaves my skin more hyrdated when I use it consistently everyday. Would highly recommend for dry skin!
I do not have acne prone skin and this product broke me our severly! Painful pimples that took weeks to heal. Would not recommend.
ran out of my normal moisturizer and decided to try a new one this is a very gentle and fast absorbing moisturizer and keeps your face smooth and hydrated throughout the day price is very good
Left my skin drier than before putting it on. Made my skin flake for whatever reason and ended up trashing this product.

I used to sell this all the time but never fell for the hype. Finally started using it and absolutely love it! Did not make my skin oily at all! I struggle with combination skin especially an oily t zone.

At first I loved it bc it had a nice finish, blended easily, and sat well under makeup. but it broke me out SO bad after a few days of use, once I realized and stopped using it it cleared up right away. Unfortunately, I can't reccomend this moisturizer for that reason.
I have used $100 moisturizers and nothing beats this. Its so moisturizing, works well under makeup and doesnt break me out. I will buy this again and again.

I have used this a few times and I do like it for quick hydration, but I feel the consistency and wear is more like a lotion than most moisturizers I have. I plan to keep using this until it is gone to give a final review but so far it provides immediate moisture and my skin absorbs it quickly which is most likely why it is considered lightweight. I do look for moisturizers to be more long lasting where as with this I have to reapply throughout my day to avoid dry skin.
this is such a great product to have within your routine. it's a great basic moisturizer and it works well with makeup and other skin care!

avis.titre: Newest addition to my skin care routine!
avis.texte: This lightweight mosturizer is probably my go to facial mositurizer now. I have acne prone, combonation skin and this cream sits extremely well. It doesnt leave a sticky or greasy feel after applying nor cause any irritation. Perfect for everyday use.

This is definitely a lightweight moisturizer. It dries nicely and does not leave the skin feeling greasy at all. I have combination skin and get alot of oil build up on my nose and forehead usually but with this, it doesn't get like that! I do moisten my face with water before applying and that helps. Otherwise, due to it being winter, i was seeing some small dry patches here and there. I use the smoothing azelaic acid cleanser with it. And sometimes will use the hyaluronic acid serum with it as well. They dont irritate my skin at all! Im prone to acne and redness and ever since ive started using these products, i haven't experienced any.

avis.titre: You will never find a better moisturizer!
avis.texte: If you're looking for a good moisturizer THIS IS IT! It's super lightweight, creamy, and moisturizing ALL DAY! And I love that a little goes such a long way! It will definitely always be in my everyday skincare routine!

Purchased this product for my friends as a Galentine's Day gift, while also curious as to whether I'd like it or not, so I also got one for myself. I have oily skin, and I've always had issues with facial moisturizers that make my skin more oily. This product keeps the oiliness away all day. My skin feels hydrated. And I love that a little goes a long way! My skin, as well as my friends, are sensitive. However, this product gave me zero irritation.
So many products make me break out almost instantly. I LOVE this moisturizer and use it every day! It is lightweight and smooth. I would recommend to anyone with sensitive skin!!!
I actually did end up purchasing this product. A couple of times after using the sample. Great product very hydrating.Non greasy does not make you break out.

avis.titre: I absolutely love this new product I purchased!
avis.texte: I've always used a basic moisturizer, but with my oily skin I knew I needed something more nourishing that could prevent dryness without feeling heavy. This product has been a game changer — it's light, creamy, and absorbs beautifully. My skin already looks and feels noticeably better, and I highly recommend it.

Great price/ value. It is lightweight and for me it's a pretty good summer moisturizer to layer with SPF (I like Vacation Shake Shake Mineral Milk). In winter I need to layer it with a face oil. It sometimes leaves my T zone a little shiny and my cheeks are drier and sometimes it just doesn't moisturize enough on its own. It's good for the price/ value.

This moisturizer is good for the Summer because it is light weight and absorbs quickly but it doesnt cut it during Winter. After I apply my skin feels dry 10 minutes later and I end up reapplying.

avis.titre: NOT safe for acne prone skin

I love good molecules, but this product is not for me, or any other acne prone individuals.

On top of thay, it is greasy and leaves a weird residue when using.

I had seen this product online and i had bern looking for a new moisturizer from the price to hydration its perfect my only complaint is not enough product a bigger size would be amazing!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🤩💦

I love this moisturizer and this brand! I have sensitive skin and it works perfectly. Pretty much every product from this brand scans a 100% on yuka for its safe and healthy ingredients

avis.titre: Great if your not running around

It gives my skin a fresh and clean feel. I was given the large tube as part of a promotion, but once complete, I will repurchase.

I use other GM products with good results and my current moisturizer wasn't handling the winter well so I tried this and after a few weeks I'm sold for life. I pray they never change it. My skin is clearing up and looks better than it has in a long time. I add a drop of the squalane oil into the lotion and top it with a drop of the bakuchiol oil and my skin looks great. Flakes are gone and my face looks fuller.

Love this moisturizer! The price is great and it's a nice size for the money. Very hydrating, lightweight & silky. I layer this with other things & it dries nicely. Not sticky & feels very silky on. Def recommend for a everyday moisturizer.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again!

Works great before priner and makeup application and also works well as a night time moisturizer ❤️

This is a very nice moisturizer. It is light, but it works very well all day.
Really good moisturizer! I have like 5 of them that I keep in different bags so I one with me at all times. Little goes a long way!
